draw: census: all 57 witnesses of census.json, in order
transcript: The proposal artifact is canonically serialised as JSON with recursive sorted keys and no whitespace and persisted verbatim as proposal_canon.json in the run's scratch dir; a third party re-derives hProposal by computing sha256sum proposal_canon.json, then re-derives the seed by computing sha256(hProposal concatenated with the salt) — i.e. seedHex = SHA-256(hProposal || salt) — reproducing 87e7ce227d52ebe274b67580289645f54ef56fd840e996c70d15d2cb814d5e3d from hProposal 9816806489664cdf9428799855969a24c1aefcd270deee4daf2355ed02f7de1a and salt eadad4a86e85dde1e8b87782a4907fd93a863bc5e1491071394f9db90f34f9d2; since mode is census with N=57, the witness bank is the full ordered set of all 57 entries in census.json — no subset selection or shuffling is performed, the draw is simply the census in its given order, so the seed here binds the proposal and salt for provenance and audit rather than selecting among candidate witnesses.
